objective: Add a zero-cost discovery asset to the already selected itch.io activation without creating another product, another login session, or owner-delivered work.

baseline.largest_uncertainty: Qualified traffic and price acceptance; two views are insufficient to estimate conversion.

contents: US$25 Regular and US$349 Extended tier explanation

tests.copy_claims: bounded to verified kit contents and license terms

user_action_minimization.method: Batch tags and one devlog into the same seller session already required for file upload, individual price, and final publication intent.

measurement_contract.activation_proof: Logged-out page shows the free demo, US$25 Regular tier, US$349 Extended tier, and devlog.
measurement_contract.effect_window: 14 days after activation and at least 100 product views, whichever is later.
measurement_contract.withdrawal_condition: If purchases and checkout signal remain zero after the effect window, stop same-copy edits and change customer/channel/offer layer.

revenue_boundary: Prepared copy, prices, and scenarios are not realized or contracted revenue. Only verified platform receipts count.
